demetrius.title: Demetrius
demetrius.about: Man living at the time of the New Testament
demetrius.note: A silversmith in Ephesus who made shrines of Artemis. He saw Paul's preaching killing his trade and started a riot, and the crowd chanted for two hours before the city officials calmed it.

diotrephes.title: Diotrephes
diotrephes.about: Man living at the time of the New Testament
diotrephes.note: John rebukes him for loving to be first. He would not welcome the travelling missionaries, spread malicious talk about John, and threw out the members who did welcome them.

gaius-2.title: Gaius
gaius-2.about: Man living at the time of the New Testament
gaius-2.note: A man from the New Testament, and 3 John is the only book that names him.
